name: inventarium-workspace
description: Workspace root for inventarium — the kanban board where your team's AI coding agents share a brain. Publishable packages live in packages/*.

scripts.dev:server: lsof -ti:3002 | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null; sleep 0.3; bun --watch packages/server/src/index.ts
scripts.reset:port: lsof -ti:3002 | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null; lsof -ti:3003 | xargs -r kill -9 2>/dev/null; echo 'ports 3002 + 3003 freed'
